description: Check an eSIM order after payment: whether it completed and whether its eSIMs have been provisioned yet. Identified by the order id together with the email that bought it, both of which are on the buyer's confirmation email. Provisioning usually finishes within a minute of payment, so an order that is paid but lists no eSIMs yet is normal: check again shortly. Once an eSIM is listed, use get-esim-activation to fetch its QR code and install details.

email.description: The email address the order was bought with. Required: the order id alone does not identify a buyer.

order_id.description: The order id from the buyer's confirmation email or order page.

name: get-order-status

esims.description: Every eSIM provisioned on this order. EMPTY while provisioning is still in flight, which is normal for the first minute after payment and never means the order failed.

iccid.description: The eSIM's ICCID. Pass it to check-esim-usage or list-topup-options.

status.description: eSIM state, e.g. "active", "pending", "expired". Null before the supplier has reported one.

note.description: What to do next, given the list above.

placed_at.description: When the order was created, ISO 8601. Null on the rare row that has no timestamp.

status.description: Order state, e.g. "completed" or "pending". "completed" is about the eSIM having provisioned, not about the money.

title: Get order status
